newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Covance upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Covance upgraded to buy.

text.p: -- Vector Securities International Inc said on Monday it upgraded Covance Inc to buy from attractive with a 12-month price target of $25.

-- Vector said the stock has fallen below $18, a level at which it believes investors can aggressively buy the stock. Positive fundamentals for the company are also likely to be highlighted over the next several weeks with the release of first-quarter earnings, Vector said.
-- Vector is estimating that Covance's earnings will reach $0.15 a share in the first quarter, up from $0.13.
-- Covance, which provides product development services to biotechnology, pharmaceutical and medical device industries, was recently spun off from Corning Inc.
-- Covance shares closed down 5/8 Monday at 17-1/2.
